== Overview ==

Cloudflare's internet proxy desktop client, free for individual use.

[https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/team-and-resources/devices/cloudflare-one-client/ Official presentation]

== Installation ==

See [https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/team-and-resources/devices/cloudflare-one-client/download/ official instruction].

=== Linux ===

See [https://pkg.cloudflareclient.com/ official repo].

<blockquote>
Possible error: 

<pre>
E: The repository 'https://pkg.cloudflareclient.com xxx Release' does not have a Release file.
</pre>

Cloudflare's repository is configured differently for each distro. For some derivative distros, it may be necessary to set target distro to an supported upstream codename. 

For instance, for `Linux Mint Xia`, one would set to `Ubuntu Noble`.

<syntaxhighlight lang=bash copy>
sudo nano /etc/apt/sources.list.d/cloudflare-client.list
</syntaxhighlight>

Replace content with:

<syntaxhighlight lang=bash copy>
deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloudflare-warp-archive-keyring.gpg] https://pkg.cloudflareclient.com/ noble main
</syntaxhighlight>

Then rerun

<syntaxhighlight lang=bash copy>
sudo apt update && sudo apt install cloudflare-warp
</syntaxhighlight>

</blockquote>
